title: Floodplain/Stormwater Project Inquiry
description: Use this service request for miscellaneous issues or concerns regarding floodplain construction projects. This request can also be used for customers requesting a new storm drain to be installed. The estimated response time for this service request is 5 business days.

observedQuestions.question: What is the project #?

observedQuestions.question: Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 inquiry about a floodplain construction project.
actions.why: Ask about a floodplain construction project or report a miscellaneous concern about one. The 311 request form asks whether project signs are posted and, if they are, requests the project number.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Floodplain/Stormwater Project Inquiry"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Floodplain/Stormwater Project Inquiry"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a new storm drain.
actions.why: Request installation of a new storm drain. The description for "Floodplain/Stormwater Project Inquiry" requests on the Dallas 311 website explicitly includes this purpose; the 311 request form asks whether project signs are posted and requests a project number only if they are.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Floodplain/Stormwater Project Inquiry"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Floodplain/Stormwater Project Inquiry"
